name: Beast Control
source:
Visual Novel Porn Parody where you control a Beast Boy that embraces his animal side and his newfound powers!
Use your powers to “help” other also unleash their animal side!
Create your Beast Harem!
translation:
视觉小说色情模仿，你控制一个野兽男孩，拥抱他的动物一面和他新发现的力量！
用你的力量“帮助”其他人也释放他们动物的一面！
创建你的野兽后宫！
